status: Verified source changes; not committed, pushed or released. Original installed runtime restored after QA.
scope: Phase 2 settings, reminders, recurrence and common event actions. Existing phase 1 planner/cache work remains included in the candidate build.

phase2.description: Immutable working-source snapshot immediately before phase 2; includes uncommitted phase 1 improvements. This is not the Git HEAD.

runtime.description: Original published 1.26.0 runtime; real UI comparison measures combined phase 1 and phase 2 changes.

changes: Settings saves accept explicit keys at owned mutation sites; unknown callers retain full validation. Avoid renormalizing unchanged external events/custom calendars. Keep the same persisted settings data and one saveData call per save.
Plan-note collapse/expand syncs existing panel DOM. Yearly expansion refreshes yearly views; monthly and yearly plan-note paths refresh their affected view groups.
Reminders update affected file metadata; rebuild only on broad invalidation. Preserve notice ordering, fired keys, minute behavior, scan scope and unload cleanup.
Recurrence expansion skips nonmatching daily/weekly dates and reuses conversion results only within one call. Preserve output identities, order, colors, range ends, leap months and exclusions.
External calendar settings and editor split into focused modules; common external/recurrence event actions shared across four view implementations.

recurrence.scope: Pure recurrence expansion plus virtual-event construction; each run owns a fresh calendar cache. No UI, disk I/O, external ICS, or persistent cache.

reminders.limitations: Offline fake host; timing is metadata update processing, not whole-app or physical-device latency.

settings.method: Real save methods with JSON serialization and counted refreshes; excludes filesystem writes and UI render cost.

realObsidian.method: Existing view state and viewport; warm-up render and 250ms settle, then 31 synchronous render calls. Content hashes, chip counts and element counts must match. Does not measure startup or end-to-end paint latency.

realPanelToggle.method: Two directions, for functional comparison only; insufficient samples for a latency improvement claim. Includes existing saveData.

npmCiDevelopmentAdvisories.note: Existing development-only dependency findings; dependencies and lockfile unchanged in this phase.

cleanSnapshot.lintInitialFailure: Unused helper in newly retained settings DOM comparison script; removed and full gate rerun passed.

verification.actualRuntimeErrors: No errors or error console messages captured while CDP debugger was attached.

preservation.externalCacheChanges: Existing startup refresh changed fetchedAt and event array order; all 24 event identities and per-identity values are unchanged.

structure.method: Same source-only scope src/, LF physical lines; baseline filesystem and candidate tracked-plus-unignored selection both contain all source files. Dependencies, backups and build artifacts excluded. These are structure counts, not speed metrics.
